name: deltac_hsi
info: Local density cut-off distance (d_c) in the HSi part. Only indices 2 and 3 (CE-H low/high density) are actually read by this producer; indices 0 and 1 are inert here but set to the same value for simplicity. Default value is 1.3.

name: deltao_hsi
info: Outlier distance (delta_o) in the HSi part. Only indices 2 and 3 (CE-H low/high density) are actually read by this producer; indices 0 and 1 are inert here but set to the same value for simplicity. Default value is 2.6 (same range as deltac/deltas, since this parameter did not exist independently before the split; no separate historical range to reuse).

name: deltas_hsi
info: Seed-promotion distance (delta_c) in the HSi part. Only indices 2 and 3 (CE-H low/high density) are actually read by this producer; indices 0 and 1 are inert here but set to the same value for simplicity. Default value is 1.3 (same range as deltac, since this parameter did not exist independently before the split; no separate historical range to reuse).

name: ecut_hsi
info: RecHit energy threshold in HSi part. Scalar parameter, unaffected by the parameter splitting. Default value is 3 (in units of MIPs).

name: kappa_hsi
info: Seed density threshold in HSi part. Scalar parameter, unaffected by the parameter splitting. Default value is 9 (in units of MIPs).
